info.name: GMPSignal — 40 Enterprise Data, Crypto, Quant, B2B, KYB, Cyber & Regulatory APIs
info.description: Official Postman Collection v2.1 for all 40 production-grade Apify Actors published by GMPSignal (@gmpsignal). Set your {{APIFY_TOKEN}} collection variable to execute any endpoint synchronously and receive structured JSON dataset items.

item.name: 1. Flagship Global Crypto, Quant, B2B, KYB, Cyber & R&D APIs (16)

request.description: Scan DEX tokens across Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and BSC using DexScreener and GoPlus Security APIs to detect honeypots, mint/freeze authority, buy/sell taxes, and liquidity locks.
Analyze live Level-2 order book depth, $10k/$50k/$100k execution slippage, and cross-exchange arbitrage spreads across Binance, Bybit, Kraken, Coinbase, OKX, and KuCoin.
Screen EVM and Solana wallet addresses for native balances, transaction velocity, mixer exposure, sanctions flags, and automated AML risk scores.
Monitor DeFi yield farming APY pools, multi-chain protocol TVL momentum, and stablecoin peg health using live DeFiLlama intelligence.
Fetch real-time implied probabilities, yes/no odds, trading volume, liquidity, and arbitrage opportunities across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Manifold Markets.
Enrich B2B company domains with decision-maker emails, phone numbers, social profiles, 38+ technology stack fingerprints, MX/SPF/DMARC security posture, and RDAP registration data.
Screen corporate entities and individuals against GLEIF Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI), OFAC/UN/EU global sanctions lists, and PEP compliance databases.
Correlate CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), FIRST.org 30-day EPSS exploitation probabilities, and NVD CVSS v3 severity scores for DevSecOps prioritization.
Discover high-traction startups and open-source developer tools across Y Combinator (YC), GitHub Trending repositories, and Hacker News launches.
Search peer-reviewed scientific papers, citation velocity, DOI metadata, and open-access PDFs across OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, and arXiv.
Extract complete product catalogs, SKU variants, stock availability, compare-at prices, and discount percentages from any global Shopify store domain.
Monitor consumer product safety recalls across US CPSC, USDA FSIS, and European Safety Gate (RAPEX) alerts.
Track cross-verified global and regional seismic events in real time across USGS, EMSC, and AFAD networks.
Search European Union Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) public procurement notices, CPV codes, contracting authorities, and official PDF/HTML links.
Monitor US FDA pharmaceutical, medical device, biologics, and food GMP inspection warning letters and violation categories.
Extract real estate, vehicles, and marketplace listings across North Macedonia (Pazar3.mk), Kosovo (MerrJep.com), and Albania (MerrJep.al).

item.name: 2. European, Balkan & Regional Market Intelligence APIs (24)

request.description: Extract residential and commercial real estate listings, square-meter pricing, and agent details across regional cities.
Fetch official US SEC EDGAR corporate filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4 insider transactions) by ticker, CIK, or form type.
Search official German Federal Employment Agency (Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit) job vacancies, employers, and locations.
Query official US openFDA drug, medical device, and food recall enforcement reports.
Extract marketplace, automotive, and real estate listings from Njuskalo.hr in Croatia.
Extract marketplace, automotive, and real estate listings from Bolha.com in Slovenia.
Extract vehicles, real estate, and consumer goods listings from OLX.ba in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Monitor TRY and USDT cryptocurrency trading pairs, 24h volume, and order book spreads across Turkish crypto exchanges (BtcTurk, Paribu).
Extract real estate, apartments, and automotive classifieds from HaloOglasi.com in Serbia.
Search and extract product listings, prices, and seller details from KupujemProdajem.com in Serbia.
Fetch live Turkish gold prices (Gram, Quarter, Half, Republic, Ons) and compare buy/sell spreads across 35 commercial banks.
Retrieve official Turkish State Meteorological Service (MGM) current weather observations and 5-day forecasts across 81 provinces.
Fetch real-time European and Mediterranean seismic events, epicenter coordinates, depths, and magnitudes from EMSC.
Calculate daily and monthly astronomical Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) and Qibla direction for any global city.
Find daily emergency on-duty pharmacies with addresses, phone numbers, and map coordinates across provinces and districts.
Fetch official Central Bank (TCMB) daily foreign exchange buying, selling, bank-note, and cross rates.
Retrieve daily retail gasoline, diesel, and autogas (LPG) pump prices across all 81 provinces.
Compare daily car rental fleet prices, vehicle classes, transmission types, and supplier ratings across airports and cities.
Extract hotel nightly rates, guest review scores, star ratings, board types, and amenities across Turkish destinations.
Retrieve official AFAD (Disaster and Emergency Management Authority) real-time earthquake records across Turkey and neighboring regions.
Compare domestic and regional airline ticket fares, departure/arrival times, baggage allowances, and carriers (THY, Pegasus, AJet).
Extract trending discussion topics, user entries, favorite counts, and community sentiment data.
Fetch maritime ferry timetables, operators, sailing durations, and ticket prices across Aegean, Marmara, and Greek Island routes.
Extract intercity bus schedules, coach operators, departure/arrival terminals, seat configurations, and TRY ticket prices across Turkey.
